missing_data_policy: Exclude a session with any missing timestamp or metric; preserve its record and report excluded counts. Never impute a score. Reject invalid, mismatched, duplicate, or unassigned sessions.
purpose: Calibration of F02 instruments and difficulty judgments; no gold or DB seed

target_fit.aggregation: Mean for accuracy; median for all other metrics. Inclusive bounds. Each metric must pass; missing data is insufficient evidence.

level_separation.design: Randomly assign high_1 students between high_target (frozen high_1 passage) and middle_anchor (frozen middle_1 passage); each student reads one F02 version only. The high_target arm serves target fit and common-grade comparison. Do not infer separation by comparing middle_1 and high_1 target cohorts.
level_separation.primary: Median reasoning_burden(high_1 passage) - median reasoning_burden(middle_1 passage) reaches minimum_reasoning_burden_gap
level_separation.secondary: At least one of lexical_burden or sentence_burden median differences reaches minimum_language_burden_gap
level_separation.decision: PASS only when primary, secondary, and both comprehension floors pass; FAIL when complete eligible arms violate any condition; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
level_separation.measurement_caveat: Anchor cohorts need parallel, independently reviewed questions with common constructs and blinded scoring; version-specific item differences and sample uncertainty remain calibration findings. Do not claim generalizable level separation from this one pair.

rationale: These are deliberately broad operational pilot bands, not published Korean grade norms. The two variants share a language band, so the initial separation hypothesis centers on reasoning burden and asks for at least one language-burden signal. A human lead must review and seal the numbers, instruments, allocation, missing-data rules, and administration before seeing responses. A revision after response access starts a new study.
